rounding_analysis.assumption: Latencies and speedups are independently rounded to nearest 0.01; this is an analytical assumption, not a verified author rounding policy.
rounding_analysis.method: For displayed baseline a and latency b, bound the underlying ratio by (a-0.005)/(b+0.005) and (a+0.005)/(b-0.005). Compare with reported speedup plus/minus 0.005. Closed intervals conservatively include rounding ties.

rounding_compatible_mismatch.interpretation: Underlying unrounded latencies could reconcile this cell; do not classify it with the two robust inconsistencies.

pdf_verification.limit: Arithmetic consistency is not experimental reproduction. Two ratios remain inconsistent under the stated rounding assumption and appear exchanged, but raw runs are needed to identify which source values are wrong. A third strict displayed-value difference is rounding-compatible, not a proven error.
